title: Ghost Rider — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. Marvel had previously used the name for a Western character whose name was later changed to Phantom Rider. The first supernatural Ghost Rider is stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze, who agrees to give his soul to "Satan" (later revealed to be an arch-demon named Mephisto) to save the life of his foster father.

The nihilist does not deny Ghost Rider — he only refuses to flatter it. Because of the color of her skin and his father's religious views, the couple kept their love a secret from the world. Shortly after the marriage, Magdelena discovered that Pastor Kale was a servant of Mephisto.
